entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today was a day more important than..."
entries.dialogueText: Today was a day more important than my coronation, my wedding, even my birth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today was the day I would make the..."
entries.dialogueText: Today was the day I would make the Kingdom of Rizia ascend closer to the heavens.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had to prepare my attire for the..."
entries.dialogueText: I had to prepare my attire for the momentous balcony speech I would make. I thought about what to hold in my hand.
